Watch connection

USB → IrDA SIR
USB IrDA ↔ watch

Connect the infrared adapter to USB. On the watch, select IR → PC and face its infrared window toward the adapter, about 5–10 cm apart.

Connect USB first. In Photos, choose Receive photo or To watch. The transfer window shows which watch mode to use and when to press its front button.
